_howto: Add a new entry to 'messages' each day. Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the date and text. Every block needs a comma after it EXCEPT the last one. Keep the ] and } at the bottom.

messages.text: After a day like today I just want to write to you. You are the greatest thing to ever happen to me. You bring me peace in moments where my own mind can't find a way to calm itself down. You make the darkest times shine like the light of the 100 suns. It's hard to even put into words the effect you have on my life, but I am so grateful for you. I love you more than you'll ever imagine. Thank you for coming into my life. Thank you for loving me as deeply as you do. I promsie to always love you with my entire heart. I promsie to defend you always. I promsie to do everything in my power to make you happy and feel loved no matter what. You're my love, my life, my everything.
